title: fix(lint)!: os validate and os build resolve a dashboard's dataset through the reader's declared closure, as the runtime does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DBn4gL62mrYxWRcYAVbim4w)_

Fixes #32967
Fixes #32929

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os validate` / `os build` 在多包产物的逐包检查里，看板组件读的 dataset 改为按读取方声明的依赖闭包解析（与运行时一致）。HotCRM 这种「app 包看板读自家模块的数据集」作者期就报错（exit 1），提示里按产物实际情况给出可行的改法：模块已依赖 app 时说「成环，把看板搬进模块，或把数据集搬进 app」。闭包里两个包都持有同名数据集也报错，不再随手挑一个。顺带把 core 拒绝语、`os migrate stored-references`、CLI 选项列表提示、发布探针里的同类句子补齐（只有环境持有时只说搬入；多个持有者时只让依赖其中一个）。
- 为什么改：裁定 #32929 选二（6840360115、6840525219）：规则不动，作者期提前报错。之前作者期说可以、运行时 409，两边不一致。
- 风险与回滚：作者期新增拒绝（元数据协议种类 narrowed，`@objectstack/lint` 升 minor，已登记 ADR-0087 升级指南条目 `dashboard-dataset-outside-reader-closure-refused`），只在带 `packages[]` 的多包产物的逐包检查里生效；读取方声明了产物里没有的依赖时只给警告不拒绝（那个包装上后可能就持有该数据集）；本仓 examples 受影响 0 个，第一方已知 HotCRM 1 个（HotCRM 已自修，看板已搬进 revenue 模块）。运行时答案不变，只有拒绝语变长。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.ts` 的 `indexArtifactDatasetResolution`（闭包与歧义判断）和 `datasetRefusalWording`（选哪种改法）；`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts` 的 `outside-closure` 分支。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/dataset-app-reads-module.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 9/9 通过：HotCRM 形态 `os validate` exit 1 且运行时 409；搬进模块后 exit 0 且 200；app 反向依赖模块启动失败（成环）；顶层另有残余数据集时整体检查照旧放行；声明了产物外依赖时只警告、exit 0。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` teaches neither cross-package dataset resolution nor `widget-dataset-unknown`.

**BREAKING** accept-set narrowing in the authoring doors (`os validate`, `os build`, `os lint`; `@objectstack/lint` `minor`): a package dashboard widget whose `dataset` only a package outside the reading package's declared dependency closure holds, or two packages inside it hold, is refused where it was accepted. ADR-0087 upgrade-guide entry `dashboard-dataset-outside-reader-closure-refused` (registered in the changeset).

## What changes

| Door | FROM (main 2c98485d) | TO |
|---|---|---|
| `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint`, per-package pass: a package's dashboard widget whose `dataset` only a package OUTSIDE its declared dependency closure holds (HotCRM's shape) | accepted (#25514 read every body of the artifact) | `widget-dataset-unknown` error naming the dataset, the holders and the open fix |
| same, a name TWO packages inside the closure hold | the first body's dataset picked | `widget-dataset-unknown` error naming both: nothing picks one |
| same, outside the closure, and the reading package declares a dependency the artifact does not carry | accepted | `widget-dataset-unknown` **warning** ("not judged: it may come from …"), suppressible; nothing said about the installed answer (review S1, the picklist twin's arm) |
| same, a dataset of a package the reader declares, or its own | accepted | accepted, unchanged |
| per-package pass, a report's (or joined block's) `runtimeFilter` on a dataset the report cannot resolve for its package | judged against the first body's dataset | not judged there (the index resolves nothing); no verdict lost: `chart-dataset-unknown` already refuses that report on that pass, and the union run still judges the filter |
| the union run (including a `manifest: 'preserve'` composition whose manifest id names a body, with a residual top-level `datasets`), and any stack without `packages[]` | every body read | unchanged |
| core `outside-closure` sentence (`409` at every package-scoped by-name door), only the environment holds the item | "Declare a dependency on the package that holds it … move what reads it into that package, or move the TYPE into P" | "No package holds it, so no dependency reaches it: move the TYPE into P" |
| same, two or more package holders | "Declare a dependency on the package that holds it" | "Declare a dependency on the one package whose TYPE is meant; depending on more than one leaves the name ambiguous" |
| same, one package holder | unchanged, byte for byte | unchanged |
| `os migrate stored-references` (report reason and `bind` refusal), CLI picklist-reference hint, publish probe `widget_not_probed` fix | named only the dependency | name the move beside it; the picklist hint reads the artifact and, when the holder already depends on the field's package, names only the moves |

Which item any runtime read answers, its status, code and `details.candidates` do not change.

How the authoring rule decides (`indexArtifactDatasetResolution`): on the per-package pass (`stack.manifest` IS one of the bodies, the object `packageBodyAsStack` hands; an id match alone also caught the union run of a `manifest: 'preserve'` composition, review M2) a widget's name resolves in the package's own datasets, then to the ONE holder in `packageResolutionClosure` (the walk the dataset doors resolve `?callerPackage=` by) read over the artifact's bodies, as `picklist-references.ts` already does. The fix the finding names is chosen from the artifact: a holder whose own closure reaches the reader cannot be declared back (the kernel refuses the cycle at boot), so the hint names the move; otherwise the dependency entry. When the reading package declares a dependency the artifact does not carry, an outside-closure name is a warning that names those dependencies, as `picklist-references.ts` reports its twin; two holders inside the closure stay an error whatever is installed. Neither arm reaches the publish door: its write snapshot (`buildRuntimeWriteSnapshotSet`) carries the context collections and the subject only, never `packages[]`, so the warning needs no user sentence of the kind #33118 gave the advisory ids the door returns (pinned).

Upgrade path: ADR-0087 semantic entry `dashboard-dataset-outside-reader-closure-refused` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`), surfaced in the protocol 18 upgrade guide and in `os migrate meta`'s guidance (which names no tracker id: review M3).

The nits carried in 6841428662: N1 and N2 in `packageScopedRefusalMessage`; N3 in `stored-package-references.ts` (and its report twin in `commands/migrate/stored-references/index.ts`); the picklist hint and the probe's `widget_not_probed` fix listed by #32982's body. N4 (`32310`'s "The remedy." paragraph) is released text in `packages/rest/CHANGELOG.md` (18.4.0), which a code PR does not edit; the new changeset carries the corrected remedy instead.

HotCRM (sister repository, not edited here): its self-fix already moved the CRM Overview's List Price by Category chart with `product_metrics` into the revenue module (hotcrm `test/package-ownership.test.ts`, `src/revenue/dashboards/product-catalog.dashboard.ts`), so HotCRM's current tree passes this rule.

## Why

Ruling on #32929, option two (6840360115; triage record 6840525219): the resolution rule (ADR-0150 D3 (c), N1 6729820123) stands and authoring reports it early. Epic #31527 red lines: resolution is not loosened (authoring is narrowed to the runtime's answer), ambiguity is reported (two closure holders refuse, never a pick), and this PR is independently releasable (no runtime answer moves).

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.artifact-datasets.test.ts`: the fixture pinned to HotCRM's names flipped from ACCEPT to REFUSE, plus: the dependency arm when the holder does not depend on the reader, two holders outside the closure, two holders inside it (red line 2), own-dataset precedence, the declared dependency accepted, the union run of a real `composeStacks(…, { manifest: 'preserve' })` artifact with a residual top-level `datasets` and a module dashboard on the module's own dataset unchanged (M2), a dependency outside the artifact reported as a suppressible warning without a 409 claim (S1), an outside dependency never softening a closure ambiguity, neither arm reaching the publish door, the rule table reached. The M2 pin's CONTROL is the per-package pass of the same composition refusing the app's dashboard on the module's dataset (review n1).
- `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.test.ts`: environment-only holder (N1), two package holders (N2).
- `packages/cli/src/utils/picklist-references.test.ts`: the cycle arm of the picklist hint.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes-dataset-holders.test.ts`: the probe's fix names the move.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/dataset-app-reads-module.dogfood.test.ts` (new): the three cells of the card on real doors: cell 1 `os validate` exit 1 + dataset door 409 (single and batch); cell 2 `os validate` exit 0 + 200 for the module's reader; cell 3 the app declaring its module refuses boot (`Circular dependency detected`); M2 `os validate` exit 0 on the residual-dataset composition; S1 `os validate` exit 0 with the warning.

## Acceptance notes

- **Item 2 of the card, measured: the runtime does NOT refuse** an app-package action of `type: 'flow'` that starts a flow its own module holds (HotCRM's `campaign_contact_member_enroll`, `campaign_lead_member_enroll`, `quote_generation` shape). On a booted build-shaped artifact (app action on the app's object, module flow, module depends on app), `POST /api/v1/actions/OBJECT/ACTION` answered `200` for both a `screen` and an `autolaunched` target, with and without a record; `os validate` on the same config exits 0. By design: `flowServiceForCaller` (`packages/runtime/src/flow-slot-view.ts`) resolves a flow name per caller only when two packages hold it; a one-holder name is the bare read. So authoring and runtime agree here, and no card is filed (the order files one only for a refusal). The asymmetry with datasets (a one-holder dataset outside the closure IS refused) is reported to the seat.
- **Not in this PR, carried by #33128 (the report half of #32967, filed by the seat):** `chart-dataset-unknown` (`validate-chart-bindings.ts`, which judges a report's and a chart's `dataset`) indexes `stack.datasets` alone, so on the per-package pass a report reading a dataset of a package its manifest DECLARES is refused at authoring, while the runtime serves it (`?callerPackage=`, 200). Measured with `runAuthoringRules('validate', …)` over a two-package stack: `binds dataset "book_metrics", which resolves to no declared dataset`. The file is outside the claim's surface; #33128 carries it.
- A composed stack's residual (top-level) dashboard is judged only by the union run, which has no package provenance, so it keeps reading every body; the per-package pass does not walk the residual.
